Same class of drift later found in H3 R2V (run 5).

resolution: Queued with the input key corrected to 'first_frame' instead of 'image'. production/workflows/h3_i2v.json was NOT modified on disk — the fix was applied to the in-memory prompt JSON at queue time only.
notes: wall_seconds measured directly from ComfyUI /history (execution_start to execution_success); this run completed after the mid-session ComfyUI process restart (~14:58), so it is still present in the live history API. peak_vram was not polled during this manually-queued run (the automated VRAM-polling driver script had already halted at the run-5 schema mismatch), so it is recorded as NA rather than estimated.
